label-new-race-name: What's the name of this race?
label-load-track: Load track from Track Editor link
label-load-tournament: Load tournament from Tournament Generator link
button-race-mode-time-attack-description: In this mode, each car is timed separately. Timing starts when the car first passes under the lap timer.
button-race-mode-final-description: In this mode, timing starts simultaneously for all cars when the green lights go out.
button-race-mode-endurance-description: Endurance mode is not available yet.
label-round-laps-desc: On very short tracks, you may want to use more laps per round. The default is 3.
label-start-delay-desc: Maximum time after the race starts for a car to cross its first sensor. The default is 3 seconds.
label-average-speed-desc: Estimated average car speed for this race, in m/s. Adjust it until the estimated round time looks realistic.
label-time-threshold-desc: Allowed variation from the estimated time between sensor crossings. Crossings below the minimum are discarded; a car that exceeds the maximum is marked as out. The default is 40%.
label-time-estimated-cutoff-min: LAPS WILL BE DISCARDED IF TIME IS UNDER:
label-time-estimated-cutoff-max: CARS WILL BE CONSIDERED OUT IF LAP TIME IS OVER:
label-time-warning:
Warning: with the current settings, a round may last longer than 99.999 seconds.
Cars are automatically marked as out when their total time exceeds 99.999 seconds.
Reduce the number of laps, increase the estimated speed, or use a shorter track.
label-hardware-pin-settings-desc: Change these values only if the Arduino wiring has changed. Incorrect pin assignments may prevent the sensors and race controls from working.
label-sensor-reading: Sensor readings — make sure all lanes show 1
label-start-button: Start button pin (set to 0 to disable)
label-paypal: If you enjoy this program, buy me a coffee!
dialog-configuration-error-detail: The configuration has been reset to its default values. Review the Configuration page for any changes. A copy of the previous configuration file has been saved to:
dialog-new-race: Start a new race? All data for the current race will be lost.
dialog-disconnected: The lap timer is not connected. Check the USB cable.
dialog-sensor-error: Sensor error: no light is reaching the sensor in lane:
dialog-enter-final: Start the finals? Make sure all racers' times are correct and final. The race mode will switch to Final mode.
dialog-restart: The app will reload to apply the changes.
dialog-disqualify: Disqualify this result? It will be recorded as DNF.
dialog-replay-round: Run this round again? Its current data will be lost.
